threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Lack of availability of raw materials at economical prices could also affect the profitability." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

threats.point: The company's major customer is setting up its own lead smelter which will affect total volume offtake and could impact sales.

This will affect the total volume offtake and could have an impact on the sales of your company." (annual report - 2024-03-31)
